vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: prospect
Version: 2.0.0

The 'Prospect' skill bundle is a purely instructional set of markdown files designed to guide an AI agent in scoring and prioritizing sales targets. It contains no executable code, external dependencies, or instructions that would lead to data exfiltration or unauthorized system access. All files, including skill.md and skill.json, are consistent with the stated purpose of business development and lead qualification.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only prospect-scoring helper whose declared purpose, inputs, and runtime instructions are consistent and do not request extra credentials or install code.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, and declared capabilities (filtering, ranking, gap identification, route recommendation) align with the SKILL.md content and the files (README, examples). Nothing in the manifest or instructions asks for unrelated access (cloud creds, system config, or external services).
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md provides structured, bounded instructions for scoring prospects (fit, timing, value, access), output format, and routing. It does not instruct the agent to read system files, environment variables, network endpoints, or send data to unexpected external services. It explicitly excludes finding targets or handling active conversations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — this is instruction-only, so nothing is written to disk or downloaded. This is the lowest-risk install profile.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, no primary credential, and no config paths. The instructions do not reference secrets or external service tokens, so requested access is proportional to the described functionality.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and there are no install scripts or persistent configuration changes. The default ability for the agent to invoke the skill autonomously is normal and there are no other privilege escalations or modifications to other skills.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This instruction-only skill appears coherent and low-risk: it simply defines how to score and route prospects and requests no credentials or installs. Before you use it, avoid pasting sensitive PII or secrets into prompts (the skill will evaluate any input you give). Treat its outputs as advisory — validate high-stakes decisions (legal, compliance, or regulated targeting) with humans. If you plan to chain this skill with other skills that do outreach or CRM writes, review those other skills’ permissions and credentials separately. Finally, if you prefer tighter control, only allow this skill to run when explicitly invoked rather than enabling broad autonomous invocation.
